theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the confirmed leader with the strongest durability reading (0.8), hurst_tag 'trend', full breadth (1.0), and it is crowded=false. This is the one theme where the validated absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) and durability leg agree with a non-crowded leadership structure. I lean overweight as a stay-with-the-established-trend call, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: The track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.313 over 147 calls — high-conviction-looking leadership has repeatedly been wrong on Canada. Bank scores at the top can simply mean relative defensiveness in a risk-off TSX, not genuine upside.
